selection_rule: Select the first 2,500 reviewers ordered by SHA256("42:" + reviewer_id) among those with at least five full-history positive ratings in every domain. This expands the existing nested hash cohort 2.5x, keeps genuine three-domain users, and applies no item- or held-out-outcome filter. Selection does not read test events.

split.same_timestamp_ties: Kept in the earlier split; no user timeline crosses a boundary.
